notes.title: Regular Update
notes.notes:
Well, we've got some new slimes.

-9 new Slimes, including the final evolutions of the 3 starters (water, fire, plant)
-A BIG FIX because I'd forgotten a lot of the slimes that give spawn scores
-And some minor fixes

And there you have it

Among the slimes that have been added 6 of them are made in reference to certain people, but also to French manga characters, I hope you'll have fun finding them :) 

Have a nice day.


Don't hesitate to join the discord! 

https://discord.gg/adt4bp73gS

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.notes:
-11 new slimes, including 1 secret, all with a Halloween theme
-1 new shiny slime! 
You can save in the in-game options to come back later! 

Have fun!

notes.title: TUTORIAL + BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
Hi! This is a quick update before the Halloween update with some spooky slimes.

On the menu: 
-Objects on which you place your mouse are highlighted for better visibility
-The second Slimedex page works correctly.
-Correction of visual bugs where some slimes were not visible.
You can go to the in-game options
-When you used to put slimes on sacrifice and then on sale or vice versa, the info would appear one on top of the other, now it doesn't (yay!)
-There are little arrows to change page on the SLIMEDEX! 
And best of all: there's a tutorial :) 

I'm very happy with the update, so thanks for playing along, and don't hesitate to leave a positive review :)
